title: FiberOS translation model registry
description: Machine-readable provenance for every model used to produce a shipped catalog. A locale may only be released when a matching entry exists with a verifiable license and checksum. No entry may be invented by the package.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the produced catalog

model.description: Model or provider name (e.g. the DeepL batch, a local NMT checkpoint)

license.description: License or terms under which the model output may be shipped

source.description: Where the model artifacts were obtained (URL or internal path)

checksum.description: sha256 of the model artifact used

status.description: produced = used for a shipped catalog
